tools.name: Cline
tools.tagline: Open-source autonomous AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI with Plan & Act modes and BYOK support
tools.description: Cline is an open-source (Apache 2.0) autonomous AI coding agent that plans and executes multi-file edits, terminal commands, and MCP tool calls inside your IDE with human-in-the-loop approvals, automatic shadow-Git checkpoints, and Bring-Your-Own-Key model flexibility.

pricingTiers.name: Open Source (BYOK)
pricingTiers.billingNote: Apache 2.0 extension; pay API providers directly for tokens
highlights: Full Plan & Act autonomous agent inside VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI
Bring Your Own Key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama)
Automatic shadow-Git checkpoints and MCP extensibility

pricingTiers.name: ClinePass
highlights: Bundled quotas for open-weight coding models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi)
5-hour, weekly, and monthly quota windows without juggling API keys
No per-token surprises for everyday coding workflows

pricingTiers.name: Teams
pricingTiers.billingNote: Free permanently for the first 10 seats
highlights: Centralized team billing and usage management
Role-based access control (RBAC)
Organization-wide governance policies

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
highlights: Single Sign-On (SSO) and audit logs
Custom SLAs and dedicated support
VPC or on-premise deployment options

keyFeatures: Two-step Plan and Act modes for safer multi-file code execution
Model-agnostic architecture supporting cloud APIs and local Ollama models
Shadow-Git automatic checkpoints for instant rollback of agent changes
Granular human-in-the-loop command and file-edit approvals
Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) and browser/terminal automation
pros: Zero vendor lock-in with full BYOK and local model support
Transparent pay-as-you-go token pricing plus $9.99/mo ClinePass option
Open-source Apache 2.0 licensing with automatic rollback checkpoints
cons: Requires API key setup and monitoring unless using ClinePass
Long multi-file agent loops can burn API tokens rapidly if unchecked
Runs directly in your local environment rather than a remote VM by default
tools.bestFor: Developers wanting an open-source, model-agnostic coding agent inside VS Code or JetBrains without IDE lock-in

200 daily queries and ~6 Audio/Video Overviews per day
Bundled Google ecosystem storage and AI perks

pricingTiers.name: Google AI Pro

500 daily queries and ~20 Audio/Video Overviews per day

pricingTiers.name: Google AI Ultra

Interactive Mind Maps and structured study/briefing guides

Same underlying model intelligence across Free and paid capacity tiers
